categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Fangzheng Automobile Mould Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive plastic molds, plastic parts and accessories, intelligent equipment, lithium battery precision structural parts, and lithium battery module conductive connectors. The company’s core business is automotive plastic molds, accounting for about 50% of revenue, including large injection molds, precision injection molds, and blow molds. It also extends downstream to produce plastic automotive parts and is expanding into intelligent equipment and new energy lithium battery components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced mold design and manufacturing technologies including modular 3D CAD design, micro-foam mold structure design, injection molding, blow molding, and intelligent manufacturing. It integrates industrial data platforms, machine vision sensors, and precision drive control for automated and digitalized production lines. Key technologies include heat spraying for surface treatment, multi-material co-injection, micro-foam injection, and automated EDM and coordinate measuring processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global and domestic automotive parts suppliers and OEMs, including Faurecia, Motherson Group, Draexlmaier, Mann+Hummel, MAHLE, TI Fluid Systems, and domestic leaders like Yanfeng, Aapex, and Ningbo Huaxiang. The company serves European, American, Japanese, and Chinese automotive brands, covering interior, exterior, air conditioning, and fuel system components. It also targets the growing new energy vehicle and lithium battery markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales (over 70% of revenue) and maintains overseas subsidiaries in Mexico and Germany for sales, service, and R&D support. It has expanded its market presence in Japan and North America, with strategic cooperation with global automotive groups. The company’s production and R&D facilities are mainly located in Zhejiang Province and other parts of China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Fangzheng operates mainly in the midstream of the automotive supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacturing of molds and precision components used by downstream automotive parts manufacturers. It also extends into downstream plastic parts production and upstream raw material procurement, maintaining stable supplier relationships for steel, aluminum, and other materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on automotive lightweighting, intelligent manufacturing, and new energy vehicle components. It invests heavily in R&D for advanced mold technologies, micro-foam injection, multi-material molding, and lithium battery structural parts. The 'One Body, Two Wings' strategy emphasizes mold manufacturing as the core, with intelligent equipment and new energy (lithium battery and aerospace coatings) as growth wings. Digital factory construction and talent development are also priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized automotive plastic molds, plastic parts, intelligent equipment, and lithium battery components. The company operates on an order-based production model, with sales mainly through direct sales channels to automotive parts suppliers and OEMs. It also earns investment income and government subsidies as non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Fangzheng is positioned as a leading domestic automotive plastic mold manufacturer with advanced technology and large-scale production capabilities. It competes with other major mold and automotive parts suppliers in China and globally. The company holds a strong market position supported by long-term relationships with top-tier global automotive suppliers and OEMs, and it is recognized as a key high-tech enterprise and industry leader in mold manufacturing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 970 million, a slight increase of 0.08% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 9.3 million. Total assets reached RMB 2.85 billion, up 16.77% from the previous year. The company’s revenue from new energy structural parts and lithium battery components showed significant growth, offsetting declines in mold revenue. Cash flow from operating activities improved substantially, indicating enhanced operational efficiency despite net losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Fangzheng emphasizes its comprehensive R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing technologies, and intelligent production lines to deliver high-precision, high-quality automotive molds and components. Its value proposition includes customized solutions for automotive lightweighting, integration of mold and intelligent equipment for automated production lines, and expansion into new energy vehicle battery components. The company’s strong customer base, global service network, and continuous innovation provide competitive differentiation.
